name: verify-delegation
instructions:
Black-box verify a delegated worker claim from the artifact, fixed-point inputs, success criteria, and independently reproducible read-only checks; never trust the worker narrative.

Capabilities:
- verify a delegated artifact against observable success criteria without implementation context
- inventory verifier capabilities and bind every command to provenance and a fixed-point digest
- run mandatory negative checks, independent replay, and artifact-integrity checks
- distinguish pass, fail, blocked, partial, NOT-RUN, stale, and outcome-unknown evidence
- return a bounded typed DelegationVerdict without transcripts or repair work

Canonical skill: .agents/skills/foundation/verify-delegation/SKILL.md
handoff_description: Stop after every applicable criterion, integrity check, mandatory negative test, and independent replay has an evidence record, or return a typed non-pass state explaining each NOT-RUN or refusal reason.
